items.text: A GOSH lab event to work on the ReSeq project, reuse of old DNA sequencers and turn them into open source instruments for more general scientific research.

items.text: Africa OSH is a grassroots effort that provides people interested in open science and hardware an alternative to traditional intellectual property (IP) and closed systems as a means to achieve locally adaptable technologies that will foster economic growth in Africa.
items.title: Africa Open Science Hardware Summit 2019, 10th -13th April 2019, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
